description: This PHP source file defines the class 'bugzillaxmlrpcInterface', which implements an interface for integrating with Bugzilla via XML-RPC within a larger issue tracking framework. It contains methods for connecting to Bugzilla, retrieving and creating issues, and managing configurations.

classes.name: bugzillaxmlrpcInterface
classes.description: A class providing integration with Bugzilla via XML-RPC, including methods for issue retrieval, creation, connection management, and configuration handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the interface, setting configuration and connecting to Bugzilla.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes configuration with default URLs and issue defaults if missing.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the raw API client object.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Checks if a bug ID has valid syntax.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to Bugzilla via XML-RPC.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the connection to Bugzilla is active.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves an issue's details by its ID from Bugzilla.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Fetches the status code of an issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Gets a human-readable status of an issue.

methods.name: getIssueSummaryHTMLString
methods.description: Retrieves the issue's summary as an HTML string.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if a bug ID exists in Bugzilla.

methods.name: createAPIClient
methods.description: Initializes the XML-RPC API client for Bugzilla.

methods.name: getAccessibleProducts
methods.description: Fetches products accessible to the user.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific product by ID.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new bug report in Bugzilla with a summary and description.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Indicates whether issues can be created via API based on configuration.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login to Bugzilla and returns a token.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user from Bugzilla given a user token.
